description: This Java source file defines the SmsMessage entity class for the Fineract project, representing outbound SMS messages with related properties, behaviors, and persistence annotations.

classes.name: SmsMessage
classes.description: Entity class representing an outbound SMS message, including properties like message content, recipient, status, and relationships to campaign, group, client, and staff.

methods.name: pendingSms
methods.description: Factory method for creating an SmsMessage with a pending status.

methods.name: sentSms
methods.description: Factory method for creating an SmsMessage marked as waiting for delivery report.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: General factory method to instantiate an SmsMessage with a specific status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the message content of the SmsMessage if changed, based on a JsonCommand object.
